title: Investigative Newsrooms & Open-Source Forensic Verification Collectives
description: Organizations specializing in reproducible OSINT forensics (satellite/video geolocation, chronolocation, weapons identification) and document-driven investigative journalism.

sources.name: Bellingcat
sources.ownership_and_funding: Independent Dutch foundation (Stichting Bellingcat) funded by philanthropic foundations, citizen workshops, and public grants; publishes full donor disclosures.
sources.editorial_standards: Reproducible open-source forensic methodology: every geographic coordinate, shadow-angle chronolocation, satellite pass, and public registry step is shown so readers/courts can replicate findings.
strengths: Gold-standard geolocation, chronolocation, munitions identification, and war-crimes evidentiary archiving (admissible under Berkeley Protocol standards)
Transparent step-by-step methodology allowing independent verification rather than 'trust-me' anonymous sourcing
known_limitations_and_biases: Receives grants from Western philanthropic and democratic-governance endowments, which adversaries frequently attack—agents should evaluate the reproducible coordinate/imagery proofs directly rather than relying on institutional appeal
Investigations take days to months, so not a breaking-minute ticker
sources.corroboration_pairing_rule: Verify cited coordinates, timestamps, and satellite imagery independently where possible, and pair with UN/ICC findings or wire reporting.

sources.name: ProPublica
sources.ownership_and_funding: 501(c)(3) non-profit investigative newsroom funded by philanthropic foundations and individual donors with board-enforced donor firewall.
sources.editorial_standards: Bulletproof line-by-line fact-checking, publication of underlying public-records datasets (FOIA, tax, court, EPA data), and detailed 'no-surprises' comment letters to subjects.
strengths: Deep U.S. regulatory, judicial ethics, healthcare, environmental toxicity, and tax-record investigations
Frequently releases raw cleaned public datasets and methodological white papers alongside articles
known_limitations_and_biases: Adversarial accountability journalism emphasizes institutional failures rather than routine baseline performance—check broader statistical baselines alongside investigative case studies
sources.corroboration_pairing_rule: Inspect linked primary FOIA documents, court dockets, and ProPublica Data Store methodology alongside subject responses.

sources.name: International Consortium of Investigative Journalists (ICIJ)
sources.ownership_and_funding: Independent U.S.-registered non-profit network uniting 290+ investigative journalists across 100+ countries; donor-transparent.
sources.editorial_standards: Cross-border collaborative verification across multiple independent partner newsrooms before simultaneous publication; maintains searchable Offshore Leaks Database.
strengths: Cross-border illicit finance, shell-company ownership, sanctions evasion, medical device safety, and transnational regulatory arbitrage
Structured entity-relationship databases (Panama, Paradise, Pandora Papers)
known_limitations_and_biases: Leak datasets reflect the specific corporate registries or law firms that were leaked (selection bias: absence from Offshore Leaks does not prove absence of offshore holdings, and presence of an offshore entity is not automatically illegal)
sources.corroboration_pairing_rule: Always distinguish legal offshore corporate registration from proven tax evasion or money laundering; verify against official corporate registries and court indictments.

sources.name: Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project (OCCRP)
sources.ownership_and_funding: Non-profit investigative network funded by philanthropic foundations and public international development/media-freedom grants (disclosed annually).
sources.editorial_standards: Document-mandatory fact-checking: every factual assertion in an OCCRP manuscript must link to an archived primary corporate filing, land deed, customs record, or court transcript (OCCRP Aleph).
strengths: Kleptocracy, sanctions-busting trade routes, illicit resource extraction, and transnational organized crime
Maintains OCCRP Aleph public-interest data archive indexing hundreds of millions of corporate and procurement records
known_limitations_and_biases: Partial funding from Western public media-development agencies requires extra diligence by AI agents to anchor citations in OCCRP's linked primary registry documents rather than narrative characterization alone
sources.corroboration_pairing_rule: Cite the underlying corporate/customs/court record surfaced via OCCRP Aleph and cross-reference with OFAC/EU filings or independent wire reporting.

sources.name: Centre for Information Resilience (CIR)
sources.ownership_and_funding: Independent non-profit social enterprise (UK) funded by philanthropic foundations and government human-rights documentation grants.
sources.editorial_standards: Geo-verified incident mapping (Myanmar Witness, Sudan Witness, Eyes on Russia) adhering to international legal preservation standards.
strengths: Systematic conflict incident mapping and civilian-infrastructure strike verification in under-covered conflicts (Sudan, Myanmar, Ukraine)
Disinformation network and coordinated inauthentic behavior analysis
known_limitations_and_biases: Open-source social/satellite visibility bias: incidents in internet-blackout or cloud-covered zones are systematically undercounted relative to connected urban areas
sources.corroboration_pairing_rule: Treat verified incident counts as a confirmed floor (lower bound), not total conflict casualties; pair with UN OCHA/ReliefWeb and regional reporting.

sources.name: PBS FRONTLINE
sources.ownership_and_funding: Produced at GBH Boston for the U.S. Public Broadcasting Service; funded by Corporation for Public Broadcasting, foundations, and viewer contributions.
sources.editorial_standards: PBS Editorial Standards & Journalistic Guidelines; publishes full primary interview transcripts and documentary source packages online.
strengths: Long-form reconstruction of complex geopolitical crises, wars, institutional breakdowns, and corporate misconduct
Published verbatim full-length on-the-record transcripts with primary decision-makers
known_limitations_and_biases: Long production lead times mean findings synthesize recent history rather than daily developments
sources.corroboration_pairing_rule: Use FRONTLINE full transcripts as primary-attributed testimony and pair with current wire updates for post-broadcast developments.
